steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Key movements: Bauhaus (form follows function, industrial production), Art Deco (geometric, luxurious), Memphis (playful, postmodern), De Stijl (abstract, primary colours). | Key Fact: Understanding design context helps you make informed choices — every design has cultural, social and technological influences. | Key Fact: Form follows function means the shape of an object should relate to its purpose — but this principle has been both followed and deliberately challenged. | Key Fact: Your research should INFORM your own design decisions — understand WHY designers made their choices before adapting their approaches.
